## FieldkitError

Base class for every error the SDK throws. Extends `Error`. For how the API client reports the same failures, see [the client reference](@handbook:reference/client).

| Property | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `statusCode?` | `number` | HTTP status, when the error came from the API |
| `headers?` | `Record<string, string>` | Response headers |

## FieldkitNotFoundError

Extends FieldkitError.

## FieldkitRateLimitError

Extends FieldkitError. Thrown once the SDK's own retries are exhausted.

| Property | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `retryAfter?` | `number` | Seconds the API asked us to wait |

## FieldkitValidationError

Extends FieldkitError.

| Property | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `errors` | `Array<{ path: string; message: string }>` | One entry per invalid field |
